title: WORLD NEWS
note: Vendored snapshot of 13 November 2026 world news, gathered at build time from public sources. Facts are headline-level summaries; each story lists its sources.

headline: US HALTS ALL FLIGHTS
stories.sub: FAA GROUND STOP: NATIONWIDE COMMS FAILURE
stories.fact: The FAA issued a rare nationwide ground stop for all US flights on 13 November 2026 citing 'extraordinary circumstances involving communications failures'; it was lifted after about four hours, with delays stretching into the weekend.

headline: RUSSIA HIT BY
1,198 DRONES
stories.fact: Russia said its air defenses downed 1,198 Ukrainian drones overnight across many regions, one of Ukraine's largest aerial attacks of the war, hitting a Lukoil refinery in Volgograd; US-brokered peace talks are days away and Zelensky announced plans for the largest-ever prisoner exchange.

headline: IRAN HITS
BAHRAIN RADAR
stories.fact: Iran's IRGC claimed it struck and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain, calling it retaliation for a US strike on telecom infrastructure at Sirik; the US military denied any hit or damage and said it shot down two Iranian drones headed toward Bahrain.

headline: NVIDIA CEO OUT
IN SPY SCANDAL
stories.fact: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO (exit confirmed 12 November) after reports that US officials suspected a former romantic partner of being a Chinese agent; on 13 November a proposed shareholder class action was filed and the stock rebounded about 5% as the board opened an investigation. CFO Colette Kress is acting CEO.

headline: BUS CRASH
KILLS 24
stories.fact: A bus-truck collision in Golaghat, Assam, India, killed 24 people and injured 11 others.

headline: BUILDING FALLS
IN NAIROBI
stories.fact: A partially collapsing under-construction building in Nairobi, Kenya, killed six people and injured five more.

headline: COP31 CLIMATE
TALKS UNDERWAY
stories.fact: COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye (9-20 November) entered its final stretch as negotiators from nearly 200 countries worked through 100+ agreements on climate finance and emissions.

ticker_notes: New Orleans: tanker Atlantic Asphalt struck the docked river cruise boat American Heritage on the Mississippi on 13 November 2026 (collision 18:29 UTC); the boat sank/partially submerged and roughly 130 aboard were rescued with no deaths (CNN, WWL-TV). Paraguay: Ueno Bank intervention crisis since 3 November - about 3 million frozen accounts, protests, president brought down; government bid to restore confidence ongoing 13 November (CNN, The Conversation, Wikipedia: 2026 Paraguay banking crisis). Microsoft: global Azure configuration-change outage hit Microsoft 365 (Outlook/Teams, up to ~430M users) from 12 November; Microsoft reported broad recovery on 13 November (Al Jazeera, Reuters). Guatemala (dropped): US designated three Guatemalan criminal groups as FTOs (El Pais, 2026-11-13). Bangladesh (dropped): garment-worker minimum-wage deal (Reuters/NYT). Doomsday (dropped): von Foerster's 1960 Science paper predicted world population reaching infinity on 13 November 2026, a Friday the 13th; population is just over 8 billion (ABC/Popular Science retrospectives).
